official_title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE COMMISSION TO THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT, THE EUROPEAN COUNCIL, THE COUNCIL, THE EUROPEAN ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL COMMITTEE AND THE COMMITTEE OF THE REGIONS Artificial Intelligence for Europe

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Document masthead and title block: 'EUROPEAN COMMISSION' and 'COMMUNICATION FROM THE COMMISSION'.

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Foundational Commission communication in the selected 2018–2024 pathway.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Analytical assessment, separate from EUR-Lex metadata.

document_date.locator: Document masthead immediately above the title: 'EUROPEAN COMMISSION'; 'Brussels, 25.4.2018'; 'COM(2018) 237 final'.
document_date.meaning: The dated Commission masthead establishes 25 April 2018 as the issue date of the final communication.

publication_date.locator: Page heading 'Communication Artificial Intelligence for Europe', metadata line 'Publication 25 April 2018', followed by the description and official-text link.
publication_date.meaning: The Commission publication page independently establishes first official publication on 25 April 2018.

classification_evidence.locator: Title and section 1, especially the paragraphs beginning 'What is artificial intelligence?' and 'This Communication sets out a European initiative on AI'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The communication defines AI and sets out the EU's substantive AI initiative, objectives, investment, socioeconomic, ethical, and legal actions.

classification_evidence.locator: Section 1 paragraph beginning 'These are some of the many examples of what we know AI can do across all sectors', and the objectives immediately below 'This Communication sets out a European initiative on AI'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The text expressly frames AI across all sectors and across the economy, private and public sectors, rather than limiting the communication to one domain.

classification_evidence.locator: Document masthead and title block: 'EUROPEAN COMMISSION' and 'COMMUNICATION FROM THE COMMISSION'.
classification_evidence.rationale: The official text identifies the European Commission as the issuing authoring institution.

classification_evidence.locator: Metadata line 'Publication 25 April 2018' and link 'Access the text of the Communication in all languages'.
classification_evidence.rationale: An official Commission publication page identifies the publication date and links the official text.
